content.title: Seven dead, 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
content.caption: Train crash near Giza, Egypt, killing seven and injuring over 100.

slides.heading: Train Crash in Egypt
slides.text: Seven dead, 100 injured after trains collide in Giza, Egypt.

slides.heading: What happened?
slides.text: Two trains collided in Giza, Egypt, causing several carriages to derail and fall down an embankment.
slides.image_search_query: two trains colliding in Giza, Egypt

slides.heading: Why does it matter?
slides.text: The incident is the deadliest train accident in Egypt's history, with at least seven deaths and over 100 injuries.
